supersedes.reason: The v1 controller validates only WMA-shaped dependent summaries. The project objective now requires the complete WMA, Mem-Gallery, and Causal-LoCoMo surfaces before any project-owned model cleanup.

unchanged_inner_controller.role: Retains the exact v1 ownership, materialization, inventory, process, quarantine, deletion, and retained-evidence checks.

global_record_required_fields: exact frozen global-contract and WMA-table identities
exact registered-method surface for all three tracks
disjoint accepted and terminal-blocked-or-failed partitions whose union is the registered surface
terminal-accepted, hash-inventoried evidence archive for each track
all accepted and rejected evidence archived

phase_semantics.preflight: Validate the global completion record and all three retained track archives, delegate to the unchanged v1 dry-run preflight, then validate the global record again.
phase_semantics.quarantine: Validate global completion before and after the unchanged v1 exact-target quarantine phase.
phase_semantics.delete: Validate global completion before and after the unchanged v1 exact-quarantine deletion phase.

authorization: Only scripts/model_cleanup_controller_v2.py may be used for future model cleanup. The v1 entrypoint is retained solely as an inner implementation and historical artifact; direct invocation is prohibited after this successor freeze. This contract authorizes no present preflight eligibility, quarantine, or deletion.
failure_rule: A missing, rejected, unsigned, incomplete, official-value-contaminated, denominator-incomplete, archive-incomplete, or method-surface-mismatched global record stops before invoking the v1 controller. Any v1 failure retains its existing fail-closed semantics.
explicitly_prohibited: directly invoking scripts/model_cleanup_controller.py after this v2 freeze
cleaning a model after WMA alone
treating a static or causal method failure as permission to omit its registered row
using official values to complete a track surface
deleting any shared model, dataset, source, environment, result, log, manifest, evidence root, or archive
